title: adaptive_sf.py: utilization > 200 returns wrong SF instead of unconditional 12
description: Spec pseudocode states 'if utilization > 200: return 12, false' unconditionally. Implementation at lines 142-145 returns sf+adjustments instead. When baseline SF is low (7-9) and utilization > 200, the function returns SF < 12. Example: assigned_sf=7, utilization=201 returns (10, False) but spec requires (12, False).
close_reason: Fixed test_vectors.py test oracle (lines 2985-2990): changed from combined 'loss OR utilization>200' check that incremented SF before checking utilization>200, to separate checks matching spec pseudocode - loss increments SF first, then utilization>200 returns unconditional (12, False). The implementation in adaptive_sf.py was already fixed. Test suite passes for all 10 utilization vectors including utilization_high_with_sf7_baseline which now correctly expects SF=12.
